_readme: Matched after normalization: lowercase, and leetspeak read both ways (0->o, 1->i or l, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 6->g, 7->t, 8->b, 9->g, @->a, $->s, !->i, |->l). 'reserved' blocks a ticker or whole name that equals the term, also with a leading '$' or trailing digits (USDC2, $USDC). 'reservedWord' blocks a name or ticker with the term as any word or word prefix (Circle USDC, USDC Rewards, USDCR): keep it to brand words. 'word' terms must be a whole word; elongations like 'niiiigger' still match, but a real word that happens to equal the collapsed form (e.g. 'niger') does not. 'part' terms match anywhere inside a word or inside spaced-out/dotted letters (LoliDoge, PedoMoon, N A Z I, K.I.K.E). 'sub' terms match anywhere in the name/description with spaces and punctuation removed. 'allow' words are cut out before 'part' and 'sub' matching (pedometer, ashkenazi, retardant). Edit freely; restart the bot to apply.
